sanskrit: senābinduś ca rājendra krodhahantā ca nāmataḥ yaḥ samo vāsudevena bhīmasenena cābhibhūḥ sa yotsyatīha vikramya samare tava sainikaiḥ
english: And Senābindu, O lord of kings, called by name Krodhahantā, the slayer of wrath, who is the equal of Vāsudeva and of Bhīmasena, that overpowering one—he will fight here valiantly in battle against your soldiers.

sanskrit: māṃ droṇaṃ ca kṛpaṃ caiva yathā saṃmanyate bhavān tathā sa samaraślāghī mantavyo rathasattamaḥ
english: Even as Your Honour reckons me, and Droṇa, and Kṛpa, so too must that one, glorious in battle, be reckoned the foremost of chariot-warriors.

sanskrit: kāśyaḥ paramaśīghrāstraḥ ślāghanīyo rathottamaḥ ratha ekaguṇo mahyaṃ mataḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
english: The king of Kāśi, swiftest of all in his weaponry, praiseworthy, an excellent chariot-warrior, the conqueror of his enemies' cities—him I reckon a chariot-warrior of single measure.

sanskrit: ayaṃ ca yudhi vikrānto mantavyo 'ṣṭaguṇo rathaḥ satyajit samaraślāghī drupadasyātmajo yuvā
english: And this one, valiant in war, must be reckoned a chariot-warrior of eightfold measure—Satyajit, glorious in battle, the young son of Drupada.

sanskrit: gataḥ so 'tirathatvaṃ hi dhṛṣṭadyumnena saṃmitaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ yaśaskāmaḥ paraṃ karma kariṣyati
english: He has attained the rank of an atiratha, a super-warrior, reckoned the equal of Dhṛṣṭadyumna; desiring glory for the Pāṇḍavas, he will perform a supreme deed.

sanskrit: anuraktaś ca śūraś ca ratho 'yam aparo mahān pāṇḍyarājo mahāvīryaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ dhuraṃdharaḥ
english: And this other great chariot-warrior, devoted and brave, is the king of the Pāṇḍyas, mighty in valour, a bearer of the Pāṇḍavas' burden.

sanskrit: dṛḍhadhanvā maheṣvāsaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ rathottamaḥ śreṇimān kauravaśreṣṭha vasudānaś ca pārthivaḥ ubhāv etāv atirathau matau mama paraṃtapa
english: Dṛḍhadhanvan, the great archer, a foremost chariot-warrior of the Pāṇḍavas, is Śreṇimat, O best of the Kurus; and there is the king Vasudāna—both of these I reckon super-warriors, O scorcher of foes.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca rocamāno mahārāja pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathaḥ yotsyate 'maravat saṃkhye parasainyeṣu bhārata
english: Bhīṣma said: Rocamāna, O great king, a great chariot-warrior of the Pāṇḍavas, will fight in battle like an immortal against the enemy's hosts, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit: purujit kuntibhojaś ca maheṣvāso mahābalaḥ mātulo bhīmasenasya sa ca me 'tiratho mataḥ
english: Purujit Kuntibhoja, the great archer of mighty strength, the maternal uncle of Bhīmasena—him too I reckon a super-warrior.

sanskrit: eṣa vīro maheṣvāsaḥ kṛtī ca nipuṇaś ca ha citrayodhī ca śaktaś ca mato me rathapuṃgavaḥ
english: This hero, a great archer, accomplished and skilful, a versatile fighter and powerful—him I reckon a bull among chariot-warriors.

sanskrit: sa yotsyati hi vikramya maghavān iva dānavaiḥ yodhāś cāsya parikhyātāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ
english: For he will fight valiantly, as Maghavat does against the Dānavas; and his warriors are all renowned and well-versed in war.

sanskrit: bhāgineyakṛte vīraḥ sa kariṣyati saṃgare sumahat karma pāṇḍūnāṃ sthitaḥ priyahite nṛpaḥ
english: For his nephews' sake that hero, the king, devoted to what is dear and good for the Pāṇḍavas, will perform a very great deed in the encounter.

sanskrit: bhaimasenir mahārāja haiḍimbo rākṣaseśvaraḥ mato me bahumāyāvī rathayūthapayūthapaḥ
english: The son of Bhīmasena, O great king, the son of Hiḍimbā, lord of the rākṣasas, master of many illusions, a leader of leaders of chariot-bands—him I reckon highly.

sanskrit: yotsyate samare tāta māyābhiḥ samarapriyaḥ ye cāsya rākṣasāḥ śūrāḥ sacivā vaśavartinaḥ
english: He will fight in battle with illusions, my son, loving the fray, and so too the brave rākṣasas, his obedient companions.

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavo nānājanapadeśvarāḥ sametāḥ pāṇḍavasyārthe vāsudevapurogamāḥ
english: These and many others, lords of various lands, have assembled for the Pāṇḍava's cause, with Vāsudeva at their head.

sanskrit: ete prādhānyato rājan pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ rathāś cātirathāś caiva ye cāpy ardharathā matāḥ
english: These, O king, are the principal chariot-warriors and super-warriors of the great-souled Pāṇḍava, and those reckoned half-warriors as well.

sanskrit: neṣyanti samare senāṃ bhīmāṃ yaudhiṣṭhirīṃ nṛpa mahendreṇeva vīreṇa pālyamānāṃ kirīṭinā
english: They will lead in battle Yudhiṣṭhira's dreadful army, O king, guarded by the hero Kirīṭin as by the great Indra himself.

sanskrit: tair ahaṃ samare vīra tvām āyadbhir jayaiṣibhiḥ yotsyāmi jayam ākāṅkṣann atha vā nidhanaṃ raṇe
english: Against these, O hero, who advance upon you seeking victory, I shall fight in battle, longing either for victory or for death in the fray.

sanskrit: pārthaṃ ca vāsudevaṃ ca cakragāṇḍīvadhāriṇau saṃdhyāgatāv ivārkendū sameṣye puruṣottamau
english: And Pārtha and Vāsudeva, wielders of the discus and the Gāṇḍīva, those most excellent of men, I shall meet as the sun and moon meeting at twilight.

sanskrit: ye caiva te rathodārāḥ pāṇḍuputrasya sainikāḥ sahasainyān ahaṃ tāṃś ca pratīyāṃ raṇamūrdhani
english: And those noble chariot-warriors, the soldiers of Pāṇḍu's son—those too, together with their hosts, I shall face at the forefront of battle.

sanskrit: ete rathāś cātirathāś ca tubhyaṃ; yathāpradhānaṃ nṛpa kīrtitā mayā tathā rājann ardharathāś ca ke cit; tathaiva teṣām api kauravendra
english: These chariot-warriors and super-warriors I have named to you according to their rank, O king; and likewise certain half-warriors among them, O lord of the Kurus.

sanskrit: arjunaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca ye cānye tatra pārthivāḥ sarvān āvārayiṣyāmi yāvad drakṣyāmi bhārata
english: Arjuna and Vāsudeva and whatever other kings are there—all of them I shall hold off, so long as I have sight, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit: pāñcālyaṃ tu mahābāho nāhaṃ hanyāṃ śikhaṇḍinam udyateṣum abhiprekṣya pratiyudhyantam āhave
english: But the Pāñcāla Śikhaṇḍin, O mighty-armed one, I shall not slay, even when I see him with arrow raised and fighting back against me in battle.

sanskrit: lokas tad veda yad ahaṃ pituḥ priyacikīrṣayā prāptaṃ rājyaṃ parityajya brahmacarye dhṛtavrataḥ
english: The world knows this, that I, wishing to do what pleased my father, renounced the kingdom that had come to me and held fast to the vow of celibacy.

sanskrit: citrāṅgadaṃ kauravāṇām ahaṃ rājye 'bhyaṣecayam vicitravīryaṃ ca śiśuṃ yauvarājye 'bhyaṣecayam
english: I consecrated Citrāṅgada to the kingship of the Kurus, and I consecrated the child Vicitravīrya to the office of crown prince.

sanskrit: devavratatvaṃ vikhyāpya pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājasu naiva hanyāṃ striyaṃ jātu na strīpūrvaṃ kathaṃ cana
english: Having proclaimed my devotion to my vow before all the kings on earth, I would never slay a woman, nor by any means one who was once a woman.

sanskrit: sa hi strīpūrvako rājañ śikhaṇḍī yadi te śrutaḥ kanyā bhūtvā pumāñ jāto na yotsye tena bhārata
english: For that Śikhaṇḍin was once a woman, O king, if you have heard it: having first been a maiden, he was born a man; with him I shall not fight, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit: sarvāṃs tv anyān haniṣyāmi pārthivān bharatarṣabha yān sameṣyāmi samare na tu kuntīsutān nṛpa
english: But all the other kings I shall slay, O bull of the Bharatas, whomever I meet in battle—save the sons of Kuntī, O king.

sanskrit: duryodhana uvāca kimarthaṃ bharataśreṣṭha na hanyās tvaṃ śikhaṇḍinam udyateṣum atho dṛṣṭvā samareṣv ātatāyinam
english: Duryodhana said: For what reason, O best of the Bharatas, would you not slay Śikhaṇḍin, even seeing him in battle with arrow raised and bent on assault?

sanskrit: pūrvam uktvā mahābāho pāṇḍavān saha somakaiḥ vadhiṣyāmīti gāṅgeya tan me brūhi pitāmaha
english: Having said before, O mighty-armed one, 'I shall slay the Pāṇḍavas together with the Somakas,' O son of Gaṅgā—tell me of this, grandfather.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca śṛṇu duryodhana kathāṃ sahaibhir vasudhādhipaiḥ yadarthaṃ yudhi saṃprekṣya nāhaṃ hanyāṃ śikhaṇḍinam
english: Bhīṣma said: Hear, Duryodhana, together with these lords of the earth, the tale of why I would not slay Śikhaṇḍin even when I see him in battle.

sanskrit: mahārājo mama pitā śaṃtanur bharatarṣabhaḥ diṣṭāntaṃ prāpa dharmātmā samaye puruṣarṣabha
english: The great king, my father Śaṃtanu, bull of the Bharatas, righteous in soul, reached his appointed end in due time, O bull among men.

sanskrit: tato 'haṃ bharataśreṣṭha pratijñāṃ paripālayan citrāṅgadaṃ bhrātaraṃ vai mahārājye 'bhyaṣecayam
english: Then I, O best of the Bharatas, keeping my vow, consecrated my brother Citrāṅgada to the great kingship.

sanskrit: tasmiṃś ca nidhanaṃ prāpte satyavatyā mate sthitaḥ vicitravīryaṃ rājānam abhyaṣiñcaṃ yathāvidhi
english: And when he met his death, abiding by Satyavatī's wish, I consecrated Vicitravīrya as king according to the rites.

sanskrit: mayābhiṣikto rājendra yavīyān api dharmataḥ vicitravīryo dharmātmā mām eva samudaikṣata
english: Though consecrated by me, O lord of kings, and though my younger, rightly so, the righteous Vicitravīrya still looked to me for guidance.

sanskrit: tasya dārakriyāṃ tāta cikīrṣur aham apy uta anurūpād iva kulād iti cintya mano dadhe
english: Wishing then to bring about his marriage, my son, I set my mind on it, thinking, 'from a family worthy of him.'

sanskrit: tathāśrauṣaṃ mahābāho tisraḥ kanyāḥ svayaṃvare rūpeṇāpratimāḥ sarvāḥ kāśirājasutās tadā ambā caivāmbikā caiva tathaivāmbālikāparā
english: Then I heard, O mighty-armed one, that three maidens at a self-choice ceremony, all of matchless beauty, daughters of the king of Kāśi—Ambā, and Ambikā, and Ambālikā the third.

sanskrit: rājānaś ca samāhūtāḥ pṛthivyāṃ bharatarṣabha ambā jyeṣṭhābhavat tāsām ambikā tv atha madhyamā ambālikā ca rājendra rājakanyā yavīyasī
english: And the kings of the earth were summoned, O bull of the Bharatas. Ambā was the eldest of them, Ambikā the middle one, and Ambālikā, O lord of kings, was the youngest of those royal maidens.

sanskrit: so 'ham ekarathenaiva gataḥ kāśipateḥ purīm apaśyaṃ tā mahābāho tisraḥ kanyāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ rājñaś caiva samāvṛttān pārthivān pṛthivīpate
english: I, going to the city of the king of Kāśi with but a single chariot, saw those three maidens, O mighty-armed one, well adorned, and the kings, the assembled princes, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit: tato 'haṃ tān nṛpān sarvān āhūya samare sthitān ratham āropayāṃ cakre kanyās tā bharatarṣabha
english: Then, challenging all those kings who stood ready for battle, I made those maidens mount my chariot, O bull of the Bharatas.

sanskrit: vīryaśulkāś ca tā jñātvā samāropya rathaṃ tadā avocaṃ pārthivān sarvān ahaṃ tatra samāgatān bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavaḥ kanyā haratīti punaḥ punaḥ
english: Knowing that they were to be won by valour as their price, having set them upon my chariot, I addressed all the princes gathered there, again and again: 'Bhīṣma, the son of Śaṃtanu, carries off the maidens!'

sanskrit: te yatadhvaṃ paraṃ śaktyā sarve mokṣāya pārthivāḥ prasahya hi nayāmy eṣa miṣatāṃ vo narādhipāḥ
english: 'Strive, all of you, with utmost might to wrest them free, O princes; for by force I carry them off, even as you look on, O rulers of men!'

sanskrit: tatas te pṛthivīpālāḥ samutpetur udāyudhāḥ yogo yoga iti kruddhāḥ sārathīṃś cāpy acodayan
english: Then those guardians of the earth sprang up with weapons raised, crying in fury 'To arms! To arms!' and urged on their charioteers.

sanskrit: te rathair meghasaṃkāśair gajaiś ca gajayodhinaḥ pṛṣṭhyaiś cāśvair mahīpālāḥ samutpetur udāyudhāḥ
english: Those kings rushed forth with weapons raised—in chariots resembling clouds, the elephant-fighters upon elephants, and others upon horses bred for the saddle.

sanskrit: tatas te māṃ mahīpālāḥ sarva eva viśāṃ pate rathavrātena mahatā sarvataḥ paryavārayan
english: Then those kings, every one of them, O lord of peoples, surrounded me on all sides with a great host of chariots.

sanskrit: tān ahaṃ śaravarṣeṇa mahatā pratyavārayam sarvān nṛpāṃś cāpy ajayaṃ devarāḍ iva dānavān
english: Them I held off with a mighty rain of arrows, and I vanquished all those kings, as the king of the gods vanquishes the Dānavas.

sanskrit: teṣām āpatatāṃ citrān dhvajān hemapariṣkṛtān ekaikena hi bāṇena bhūmau pātitavān aham
english: Of those who rushed upon me, their bright banners adorned with gold, I cast each one to the earth with a single arrow apiece.

sanskrit: hayāṃś caiṣāṃ gajāṃś caiva sārathīṃś cāpy ahaṃ raṇe apātayaṃ śarair dīptaiḥ prahasan puruṣarṣabha
english: And their horses and their elephants and their charioteers I felled in the fray with blazing arrows, laughing the while, O bull among men.

sanskrit: te nivṛttāś ca bhagnāś ca dṛṣṭvā tal lāghavaṃ mama athāhaṃ hāstinapuram āyāṃ jitvā mahīkṣitaḥ
english: Seeing that deftness of mine, they turned back and were broken; and then, having conquered those rulers of the earth, I came to Hāstinapura.

sanskrit: ato 'haṃ tāś ca kanyā vai bhrātur arthāya bhārata tac ca karma mahābāho satyavatyai nyavedayam
english: Then those maidens, O descendant of Bharata, won for my brother's sake, and that deed too, O mighty-armed one, I reported to Satyavatī.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca tato 'haṃ bharataśreṣṭha mātaraṃ vīramātaram abhigamyopasaṃgṛhya dāśeyīm idam abruvam
english: Bhīṣma said: Then, O best of the Bharatas, approaching my mother, the mother of a hero, the daughter of the fisherman, and clasping her feet, I spoke these words.

sanskrit: imāḥ kāśipateḥ kanyā mayā nirjitya pārthivān vicitravīryasya kṛte vīryaśulkā upārjitāḥ
english: 'These daughters of the king of Kāśi, won at the price of valour, I have gained for Vicitravīrya's sake, having vanquished the kings.'

sanskrit: tato mūrdhany upāghrāya paryaśrunayanā nṛpa āha satyavatī hṛṣṭā diṣṭyā putra jitaṃ tvayā
english: Then, O king, smelling my head and with tears brimming in her eyes, Satyavatī said, rejoicing: 'By good fortune, my son, you have triumphed!'

sanskrit: satyavatyās tv anumate vivāhe samupasthite uvāca vākyaṃ savrīḍā jyeṣṭhā kāśipateḥ sutā
english: But when, with Satyavatī's consent, the wedding was at hand, the eldest daughter of the king of Kāśi, abashed, spoke these words.

sanskrit: bhīṣma tvam asi dharmajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ śrutvā ca dharmyaṃ vacanaṃ mahyaṃ kartum ihārhasi
english: 'Bhīṣma, you are a knower of dharma, well-versed in all the scriptures; having heard my words, which are righteous, you ought to act on them here.'

sanskrit: mayā śālvapatiḥ pūrvaṃ manasābhivṛto varaḥ tena cāsmi vṛtā pūrvaṃ rahasy avidite pituḥ
english: 'The lord of Śālva was once chosen by me in my heart as my groom, and by him too I was chosen before, in secret, unknown to my father.'

sanskrit: kathaṃ mām anyakāmāṃ tvaṃ rājañ śāstram adhītya vai vāsayethā gṛhe bhīṣma kauravaḥ san viśeṣataḥ
english: 'How, O king, having studied the scriptures, would you keep me in your house, Bhīṣma, when my heart longs for another—you, of all men, being a Kaurava?'

sanskrit: etad buddhyā viniścitya manasā bharatarṣabha yat kṣamaṃ te mahābāho tad ihārabdhum arhasi
english: 'Having weighed this and resolved it in your mind, O bull of the Bharatas, whatever is fitting for you, that, mighty-armed one, you ought to undertake here.'

sanskrit: sa māṃ pratīkṣate vyaktaṃ śālvarājo viśāṃ pate kṛpāṃ kuru mahābāho mayi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara tvaṃ hi satyavrato vīra pṛthivyām iti naḥ śrutam
english: 'Plainly the king of Śālva awaits me, O lord of peoples. Show mercy to me, O mighty-armed one, best of the upholders of dharma; for you, O hero, are known throughout the earth as true to your vows—so have we heard.'

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca tato 'haṃ samanujñāpya kālīṃ satyavatīṃ tadā mantriṇaś ca dvijāṃś caiva tathaiva ca purohitān samanujñāsiṣaṃ kanyāṃ jyeṣṭhām ambāṃ narādhipa
english: Bhīṣma said: Then, having taken leave of Kālī Satyavatī, and of the ministers and the brāhmaṇas and likewise the house-priests, I gave leave to the eldest maiden, Ambā, O ruler of men.

sanskrit: anujñātā yayau sā tu kanyā śālvapateḥ puram vṛddhair dvijātibhir guptā dhātryā cānugatā tadā atītya ca tam adhvānam āsasāda narādhipam
english: Given leave, that maiden went to the city of the lord of Śālva, guarded by aged brāhmaṇas and attended by her nurse; and having crossed that road, she came before the king.

sanskrit: sā tam āsādya rājānaṃ śālvaṃ vacanam abravīt āgatāhaṃ mahābāho tvām uddiśya mahādyute
english: Coming before that king, Śālva, she spoke these words: 'I have come, O mighty-armed one, seeking you, O greatly radiant one.'

sanskrit: tām abravīc chālvapatiḥ smayann iva viśāṃ pate tvayānyapūrvayā nāhaṃ bhāryārthī varavarṇini
english: The lord of Śālva said to her, with something like a smile, O lord of peoples: 'I do not desire you for my wife, O fair-complexioned one, since you have already belonged to another.'

sanskrit: gaccha bhadre punas tatra sakāśaṃ bhāratasya vai nāham icchāmi bhīṣmeṇa gṛhītāṃ tvāṃ prasahya vai
english: 'Go, gentle lady, back there into the presence of the descendant of Bharata; I do not want you, who were seized by force by Bhīṣma.'

sanskrit: tvaṃ hi nirjitya bhīṣmeṇa nītā prītimatī tadā parāmṛśya mahāyuddhe nirjitya pṛthivīpatīn nāhaṃ tvayy anyapūrvāyāṃ bhāryārthī varavarṇini
english: 'For you, having been won by Bhīṣma, were then led away content—he laid hands on you in that great battle, having vanquished the lords of the earth; I do not desire you for my wife, O fair-complexioned one, since you have belonged to another before.'

sanskrit: katham asmadvidho rājā parapūrvāṃ praveśayet nārīṃ viditavijñānaḥ pareṣāṃ dharmam ādiśan yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ bhadre mā te kālo 'tyagād ayam
english: 'How should a king such as I take into his house a woman who has belonged to another—one of discerning knowledge, who lays down the law of conduct for others? Go where you will, gentle lady; let not this time of yours slip past you.'

sanskrit: ambā tam abravīd rājann anaṅgaśarapīḍitā maivaṃ vada mahīpāla naitad evaṃ kathaṃ cana
english: Ambā said to him, O king, tormented by the arrows of the bodiless one, Kāma: 'Speak not thus, O guardian of the earth; this is by no means so.'

sanskrit: nāsmi prītimatī nītā bhīṣmeṇāmitrakarśana balān nītāsmi rudatī vidrāvya pṛthivīpatīn
english: 'I was not led away content by Bhīṣma, O harrower of foes; I was carried off by force, weeping, when he had put the lords of the earth to flight.'

sanskrit: bhajasva māṃ śālvapate bhaktāṃ bālām anāgasam bhaktānāṃ hi parityāgo na dharmeṣu praśasyate
english: 'Take me to yourself, O lord of Śālva—a devoted girl, innocent; for the abandonment of those devoted to one is not praised in the codes of dharma.'

sanskrit: sāham āmantrya gāṅgeyaṃ samareṣv anivartinam anujñātā ca tenaiva tavaiva gṛham āgatā
english: 'I, having taken my leave of the son of Gaṅgā, who never turns back in battle, and being granted leave by him, have come to your house alone.'

sanskrit: na sa bhīṣmo mahābāhur mām icchati viśāṃ pate bhrātṛhetoḥ samārambho bhīṣmasyeti śrutaṃ mayā
english: 'That mighty-armed Bhīṣma does not desire me, O lord of peoples; Bhīṣma's whole undertaking was for his brother's sake—so I have heard.'

sanskrit: bhaginyau mama ye nīte ambikāmbālike nṛpa prādād vicitravīryāya gāṅgeyo hi yavīyase
english: 'My two sisters who were carried off, Ambikā and Ambālikā, O king—the son of Gaṅgā gave them to his younger brother Vicitravīrya.'

sanskrit: yathā śālvapate nānyaṃ naraṃ dhyāmi kathaṃ cana tvām ṛte puruṣavyāghra tathā mūrdhānam ālabhe
english: 'As, O lord of Śālva, I think of no other man at all but you, O tiger among men—so do I touch my own head in oath.'

sanskrit: na cānyapūrvā rājendra tvām ahaṃ samupasthitā satyaṃ bravīmi śālvaitat satyenātmānam ālabhe
english: 'Not having belonged to another, O lord of kings, have I come before you. I speak the truth, Śālva—by that truth I touch my own self in oath.'

sanskrit: bhajasva māṃ viśālākṣa svayaṃ kanyām upasthitāṃ ananyapūrvāṃ rājendra tvatprasādābhikāṅkṣiṇīm
english: 'Take me to yourself, O wide-eyed one—a maiden come of her own accord, who has belonged to no other, O lord of kings, longing for your favour.'

sanskrit: tām evaṃ bhāṣamāṇāṃ tu śālvaḥ kāśipateḥ sutām atyajad bharataśreṣṭha tvacaṃ jīrṇām ivoragaḥ
english: But Śālva cast off that daughter of the king of Kāśi as she spoke thus, O best of the Bharatas, as a serpent casts off its worn-out skin.

sanskrit: evaṃ bahuvidhair vākyair yācyamānas tayānagha nāśraddadhac chālvapatiḥ kanyāyā bharatarṣabha
english: Though entreated thus by her with words of many kinds, O sinless one, the lord of Śālva put no faith in the maiden, O bull of the Bharatas.

sanskrit: tataḥ sā manyunāviṣṭā jyeṣṭhā kāśipateḥ sutā abravīt sāśrunayanā bāṣpavihvalayā girā
english: Then that eldest daughter of the king of Kāśi, possessed by anguish, spoke with tearful eyes, in a voice broken by weeping.

sanskrit: tvayā tyaktā gamiṣyāmi yatra yatra viśāṃ pate tatra me santu gatayaḥ santaḥ satyaṃ yathābruvam
english: 'Forsaken by you, I shall go wherever I may, O lord of peoples; wherever that be, may the good be my refuges, even as I have spoken the truth.'

sanskrit: evaṃ saṃbhāṣamāṇāṃ tu nṛśaṃsaḥ śālvarāṭ tadā paryatyajata kauravya karuṇaṃ paridevatīm
english: But as she was speaking thus, the cruel king of Śālva then cast her off utterly, O Kaurava, as she lamented piteously.
